offering_description.value: MariMed sells cannabis products to adult-use consumers and medical cannabis patients through its own dispensaries. It cultivates cannabis, makes finished products, and supplies other licensed dispensaries wholesale.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; edibles; pre-rolls; vape cartridges; concentrates

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use cannabis consumers and medical cannabis patients; B2B: licensed cannabis dispensaries and operators

revenue_model.value: product sales: retail cannabis purchases and wholesale orders from licensed dispensaries

value_chain_position.value: retailer: sells its own and third-party cannabis products to adults and patients; raw materials: grows cannabis for its own production and for sale to licensed retailers; OEM / manufacturer: processes harvested cannabis into finished products for its own stores and other dispensaries; asset operator: operates cultivation sites, processing facilities, and dispensaries serving licensed retailers and consumers
value_chain_position.category: retailer; raw materials; OEM / manufacturer; asset operator

geography_served.value: US regional: operates in selected US states including Massachusetts, Maryland, Illinois, Delaware, and Ohio

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis cultivation, finished product manufacturing, wholesale, and dispensary retail

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-operated cannabis dispensaries; direct sales: wholesale orders from licensed dispensary operators; third-party retail: independent licensed dispensaries that stock MariMed products
distribution_channels.category: own locations; direct sales; third-party retail

regulatory_exposure.value: high: state cannabis regulators license cultivation, processing, and dispensary sales, which also face federal controlled-substance restrictions

notes: The full current state footprint and the scope of any standalone management or licensing arrangements are uncertain.
